subject: Configuration section
notes: The format is `CONFIGURATION SECTION.` followed by four BRACKETED paragraph names — source-computer-paragraph, object-computer-paragraph, special-names-paragraph, repository-paragraph — and nothing else, RENDERED from the printed page (PDF p313 / printed folio 283; re-rendered w1032d). All four are modelled and all four are exercised together by the positive golden. The residue is DIAGNOSED: an unrecognized paragraph header is the shared `unrecognizedClause` error production, refused by name with COBOL1971 (kb/Work PB829). ORDER AND REPETITION (kb/Work PB1508's sibling arm, landed w1032d): §12.3.3's three syntax rules place the section and never reorder it, so §5.2.1 binds the printed sequence (cite.py --check 5.2.1 "shall be written in the compilation group in the sequence given in the general format, unless otherwise specified by the rules of that format" -> OK) and each bracket admits its paragraph once (§5.2.6.2, §5.2.7). ClauseCardinalities.ByClauseContext[ConfigurationParagraphContext] (Sequence SOURCE-COMPUTER, OBJECT-COMPUTER, SPECIAL-NAMES, REPOSITORY) is read by ClosedFormatPass: SPECIAL-NAMES before SOURCE-COMPUTER -> COBOL2987 and two SOURCE-COMPUTER paragraphs -> COBOL2423 at 85/2002/2014/2023 (both compiled clean before). Three corpus programs wrote SPECIAL-NAMES before OBJECT-COMPUTER and were corrected to the printed order (2014/pb1133, 2023/pb728, negative/pb1075-character-classification-for-repeated).
